objective: Build and prove a reusable authenticated national GBIF Darwin Core acquisition, replay, and state-partition family, then execute a substantial net-new tranche only if provider and release evidence gates permit it.

providerExecution.blocker: Authenticated GBIF download execution is blocked before network because the three required credential environment variables are absent.

implementationEvidence.selectionPolicy: The complete retained 53-taxon universe is rescored from current county shards and the deterministic smallest descending prefix above 25,000 true not-researched pairs is hash-pinned.
implementationEvidence.acquisition: One non-retried authenticated POST, bounded deadline-aware status polling, resumable capped archive transfer, atomic staging, committed-input revalidation, redacted request retention, and post-rename verification.
implementationEvidence.ambiguousPostRecovery: A pre-dispatch marker prevents silent duplicate POSTs. An ambiguous outcome blocks until an operator explicitly reconciles the existing download key.
implementationEvidence.replay: Interpreted and verbatim Darwin Core tables are meta/header validated, joined by GBIF ID through bounded SQLite staging, constrained to explicit concordant state/county text, and never use coordinates to assign county.
implementationEvidence.evidenceSemantics: A complete archive can create verified-present evidence or researched-unresolved outcomes only. Silence, failed downloads, incomplete partitions, and unparsed archives cannot create absence or not-detected determinations.
implementationEvidence.partitioning: The selected manifest is partitioned deterministically across all 51 jurisdiction rows; Alabama is retained as the sole zero-selected state without emitting an empty immutable run.
implementationEvidence.integrityScaling: The integrity checker validates immutable runs one at a time rather than retaining and reloading the entire corpus. The final default-heap gate validated 996 runs and 1,514,982 outcomes.

actualResearchMovement.qualification: Selection capacity is not research movement. No provider archive was acquired or parsed, and no generated research projection changed.

fallbackExhaustion.finding: No net-new retained scope remains; AFPE work is freshness/blocked repair only.

verification.focusedNationalGbifRegression: pass: 13 taxa, 25,406 selected pairs, shuffled Darwin Core replay deterministic
verification.selectionRegeneration: pass: byte-identical to the plan-pinned SHA-256
verification.fullResearchIntegrity: pass: default heap, 996 immutable runs, 1,514,982 outcomes, zero conflicts

remainingReleaseBlockers.blocker: GBIF_USERNAME, GBIF_PASSWORD, and GBIF_EMAIL are absent; no authenticated provider execution is authorized or possible.

Generated state run receipts currently set requested_scope.date_range.end to plan.snapshotDate even though the GBIF predicate does not apply an event or modification date bound. This must be corrected to an unbounded requested date range before publication.
The partition receipt input hash map is produced by the partitioner but is not yet independently verified as an exact committed set by the composite integrity gate.
Multi-run partition publication rolls back ordinary exceptions but lacks a durable transaction manifest for process termination or power-loss recovery.
There is no fully offline end-to-end acquisition-verifier-partition materialization fixture covering all 51 partition receipt rows and deterministic rerun.

releaseDecision.reason: Round 68 completed substantial offline source-family engineering but produced zero net-new county-species research movement. Credentials and a truthful provider archive are required before the selected 25,406-pair tranche can be claimed or released.

processLesson: A national source family is not complete merely because a provider request can be issued. Selection, immutable acquisition, raw/interpreted geography reconciliation, conservative evidence semantics, partition lineage, deterministic replay, bounded integrity, and release receipts must all agree before provider-derived movement is publishable.
